---
name: implement-feature
description: Implement a bounded feature from supplied requirements and acceptance criteria.
argument-hint: Requirement or work-item link, optional scope and exclusions
---

Implement the requested feature within the user's stated scope.

1. Resolve the active repository context and read applicable project instructions.
2. Identify requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant existing behavior. Ask if a critical behavior decision is missing.
3. Inspect analogous implementations and tests before designing the change.
4. Propose a small implementation approach and identify files/layers affected.
5. Implement only approved scope, following local conventions; add focused tests for introduced behavior.
6. Run relevant checks and report changes, exact verification, limitations, and unresolved risks.

Do not switch branches, commit, push, open a PR, or change an external work item unless separately and explicitly asked.
